Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In step 4, the WebSurfer agent incorrectly concluded that "Gimme Shelter" was Oscar-nominated. The analysis of the search results showed that the visible text only mentioned the film in the context of the "Maysles Collection" archive page, not as a nominee on the official ceremony page or in the awards database. The agent hallucinated a confirmation of nomination based on the film being listed in a collection, rather than finding explicit evidence of a nomination (e.g., "Nominees: Gimme Shelter"). This led to the wrong conclusion that both films were nominated, when in fact only LaLee's Kin was nominated.
